title: How many agency RN shifts a multi-state hospital cooperative's winter surge pool should block-book for the four weeks from 4 January 2027, region by region, when this winter's respiratory surge reached the Southeast in November and Central in December and the North's eight hospitals are new to the pool
subdomain: patient flow, beds and workforce optimization (a hospital cooperative's winter agency nurse pool: the January block forecast region by region, each region's respiratory surge timed by its lag behind the region it follows, read off the closed winters' capacity census)
prompt_shape: a committed block of agency RN shifts for four weeks, each of last winter's 16 pool hospitals' funded shifts and shifts billed to the pool that it did not fund, and a weekly chart of the funded shifts labelled with the busiest week's total and the shifts billed to the pool that week

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task160/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional multi-state hospital cooperative (Georgia and South Carolina, Tennessee, Kentucky and West Virginia, northern Michigan), its 24 member hospitals and two nurse staffing agencies, in the layouts of a hospital cooperative's daily capacity reporting system before and after a system change, a surge declaration log, agency billing and payroll exports, a wastewater surveillance export and the pool's own agreement, register and order book; no real organisation's records or person is depicted.
